messages:
jordan: quick heads-up 1 1  spotted that the /v1/generate docs still show `messages: [ ... ]` in the JSON example. our openapi now validates against `input: string`. staging docs linter is failing.

lee: can you paste the failing example? i can patch it.

jordan: sure. failing snippet from docs/generate.md:

```json
{
  "messages": ["First line", "Second line"],
  "temperature": 0.7
}
```

pat: thanks. the runtime expects `input` joined by "\n" or explicit separator. suggested doc update:

```json
{
  "input": "First line\nSecond line",
  "temperature": 0.7
}
```

emma: also flagging the SSE streaming example: docs show event name `chunk` but the agent emits `choices.delta` objects (with `text`). we should standardize wording: show the raw event body and a tiny helper to extract the delta text.

jordan: good call. let's add a short migration snippet for JS + Python showing the join and the streaming extraction. example one-liners: `input = prompts.join('\n')` (js) and `input = '\n'.join(prompts)` (py).

ci-bot: docs linter error: docs/generate.md: invalid-example-schema (line 58).

lee: i'm opening a PR with three changes: replace `messages` examples with `input`, update SSE example to show `choices.delta.text` extraction, and add a Migration note under "API changes (v2)". PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/802

pat: nice. please also update language in the snippet that previously said "append to messages array" to instead show concatenation and why (ordering + separators). small UX thing.

emma: added two inline edits to the PR to clarify that SDKs accept legacy `messages` for now and that `input` is preferred. also added a tiny test in examples/fixtures/generate_schema.json to assert the example matches the openapi.

jordan: can we add a short changelog bullet and a one-sentence migration blurb in the release notes? i'd like customers to see it.

lee: added changelog entry in the PR and a draft release-note blurb. cc @marketing later.

ci-bot: PR checks: docs lint ✅, examples schema test ✅, staging build ✅.

pat: looks good to me. approving PR.

emma: approved and merged. :balloon:

jordan: great work all. small doc drift but happy it's caught by the linter. saved some confusion for users migrating from older snippets.
